introduction_markdown:
Answer both questions beginning each answer on a new page in the answer booklet. Both answers carry equal marks.

Credit will be given for accuracy, correct use of a variety of expressions, verbs, vocabulary and idioms.

Use blue ink only.

You are reminded of the necessity for orderly presentation of your answers.
enonce_intro_markdown:
*Using a tense suitable to your chosen topic, write an essay in French, of at least 140 and not more than 150 words, (not counting figures, words in brackets, abbreviations and names of people or places) on ONE of the following topics.*

*Credit will be given for the correct use of a variety of expressions, verbs, vocabulary and idioms.*

*If you choose topic (b), the letter, your name must be AKIM and your address Lycée d'Oman.*

*Use of a different name and /or address will be seriously penalised. This holds true for details that can help reveal your true identity, school and/or family. The usual introduction to the letter must not be more than 20 words.*

*If you choose topic (c), your essay must be based on the events in the picture.*

*Off-topic material will earn no marks.*

questions.corrige_markdown:
**Tense chosen:** the passé composé for the events, with the imparfait to describe the illness and how the child looked and felt. A past tense is needed because the story is told after the events. The narrator is a girl (*seule*, *aidée*) and the sister is called Aïcha; any other first name is accepted.

**Model essay** (148 words counted with everything; 147 without the name of the person)

Mes parents étaient partis en voyage quand ma petite sœur Aïcha est tombée malade. Elle avait une forte fièvre, elle vomissait et elle se plaignait de douleurs au ventre. J'étais seule avec elle et j'ai eu très peur. Je ne savais pas quoi faire.

J'ai appelé notre voisine, qui m'a aidée à l'emmener au centre de santé du quartier. Nous avons marché vite, car son état m'inquiétait. Pendant le trajet, ma sœur pleurait et elle tremblait de froid.

À l'hôpital, une infirmière l'a installée dans un lit et le médecin l'a examinée longuement. Il a découvert qu'elle avait le paludisme et il lui a prescrit des médicaments. Elle a reçu une injection et elle a dormi toute la nuit.

Heureusement, le lendemain, la fièvre avait disparu. Mes parents sont rentrés le soir même et ils m'ont remerciée de mon courage. Depuis ce jour, je surveille toujours sa santé.

**Notes**

The essay covers the three bullet points: the illness and how the child reacted (paragraph 1), where she was taken, with the neighbour's help (paragraph 2), what happened at the hospital (paragraph 3), and how everything ended (paragraph 4). The parents are away at the start, as the topic says.

**Marking criteria**

| Criterion | What earns the marks |
|---|---|
| Accuracy | Correct verb forms, agreements, spelling and accents; correct use of the tense chosen |
| Variety of expressions | Linking words (*d'abord*, *ensuite*, *enfin*, *heureusement*) and set phrases |
| Variety of verbs | Several different verbs instead of *être*, *avoir* and *faire* only |
| Vocabulary and idioms | Words and expressions suited to the topic; idioms used correctly |
| Relevance and length | All three bullet points covered; between 140 and 150 words |

**Common mistakes**

1. Forgetting that the parents were away, or leaving out where the child was taken (the second bullet point).
2. Mixing the passé composé and the imparfait without a reason: events are in the passé composé, the description of the illness in the imparfait.
